repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable principles, design foundations, process, shared semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, successor preview, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests. G7 PR #62 is deployed and awaiting explicit physical shell approval before FIRE Core breadboarding. New unresolved durable FIRE deltas use Babel Truth Issue #1 comments.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Uses prototype/fake state by default. Current Lab structure separates Fire Lab under fire/ from World Lab under world/; Achievements live in World Lab, while Fire is FIRE-bound if promoted. Lab may intentionally diverge from Truth when an experiment explicitly tests an alternative.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: World experiments currently live under babel-lab/world/. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
